purpose: Jurisdiction-aware directory of clinical information centers for Dr. Mia. This directory routes retrieval and review; it is not itself an approved prescribing knowledge base.

sources.name: American Dental Association — Acute Dental Pain Management Guideline
use_limits: Adult/adolescent 2024 resources and pediatric resources have different age scopes; select the matching population.
Do not transform into patient-specific advice until exact recommendation, source version, reuse rights, and qualified dental review are documented.

sources.name: American Dental Association — Antibiotics for Dental Pain and Swelling
use_limits: Use only within the guideline's specified populations and clinical questions.
Do not generalize to all infections, prophylaxis situations, immunocompromised patients, or children without matching evidence.

sources.name: American Dental Association — Antibiotic Stewardship: Balancing Patient Care and Public Health
sources.publisher: American Dental Association Council on Scientific Affairs / JADA
use_limits: Track the specific statement and chairside tool as separate versioned artifacts.
A stewardship statement is not a comprehensive drug monograph or full patient-specific interaction screen.

sources.name: CDC — Dental Pain and Swelling Materials
sources.publisher: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
use_limits: Confirm the exact downloadable fact sheet or content artifact and its version before creating a card.
Check embedded third-party material and intended audience.
Do not present this resource as a universal antibiotic-selection database.

additional_downloads.name: CDC Checklist for Antibiotic Prescribing in Dentistry

sources.name: American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry — Acute Pain Management for Pediatric Dental Patients
use_limits: Pediatric scope only; do not reuse adult recommendations as pediatric dosing.
Any dose-related card requires age/weight/product-form/route-specific clinical validation and exact-source review.

sources.name: American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry — Use of Antibiotic Therapy for Pediatric Dental Patients
use_limits: Pediatric scope only; confirm the current Reference Manual edition and recommendation text.
Does not replace product-specific label checks or a medication interaction service.

sources.name: American Association of Endodontists — Clinical Guidelines and Position Statements
use_limits: Use only guidelines relevant to the specific endodontic question and population.
Link-only until the rights for any copied or transformed content are confirmed.

sources.name: NLM RxNorm API
use_limits: Identity normalization only; this API is not a drug-interaction checker.
The RxNav Drug-Drug Interaction API was discontinued in 2024; do not use it.
Cache according to current NLM terms and retain NLM attribution.

sources.name: DailyMed Structured Product Labeling Web Services
use_limits: Resolve exact product, strength, dosage form, route, labeler, and label version.
Do not infer patient-specific suitability solely from a label match.
Do not ingest or redistribute label text without record-level rights review.

sources.name: FDA openFDA Drug Product Labeling API
use_limits: FDA states the data has limitations and should not be the sole basis for medical-care decisions.
Exclude or separately review records with third-party-rights warnings.
Submitted labeling may not match the label for a currently distributed product.

sources.name: FDA Drugs@FDA Database and openFDA API
use_limits: US regulatory status only; it does not establish Egyptian registration, local availability, or appropriateness for a specific patient.
Approval metadata is not a dosing guide or interaction checker.

sources.name: DrugBank Clinical API — medication search and drug-drug interactions
use_limits: No API key, license, contract, clinical display rights, or coverage validation is currently configured.
Confirm regional coverage, allowed storage/display, source provenance, clinical liability, uptime, costs, and data-processing terms before integration.
A missing or unavailable interaction result must never be represented as 'no interactions'.

sources.name: Egyptian Drug Authority — Egyptian Drug Register
use_limits: The public page lists drug-register chapters by class/year; no supported public API contract was verified.
Do not scrape at scale or assume a product is currently registered/available without confirming the exact current record.
Use alongside current product information and local clinician/pharmacist review.

sources.name: Egyptian Drug Authority — Periodic Pharmaceutical Lists
use_limits: Official lists may support regulatory/safety context but do not replace a product label, prescribing guideline, or interaction checker.
Record publication date, list edition, medicine identity, and exact source when reviewed.

sources.name: Egyptian Drug Authority — Egyptian Pharmaceutical Information Center
sources.publisher: Egyptian Drug Authority, Central Administration for Pharmaceutical Care
use_limits: Use as an expert escalation path for questions not resolved by verified references; do not represent it as an API.
Do not send identifiable patient data without appropriate consent, legal basis, and approved process.

sources.name: WHO — Egypt National Essential Medicine List 2025 (English)
use_limits: An essential-medicine list is not a patient-specific prescribing guideline, interaction database, or proof of current stock availability.
Do not apply this list to a US workflow.

sources.name: WHO Model List of Essential Medicines
use_limits: Global policy list only; it is not a substitute for the local country list or individual clinical assessment.

sources.name: PubMed / PubMed Central — biomedical literature discovery
sources.publisher: US National Library of Medicine, National Institutes of Health
use_limits: Search results and abstracts must not be treated as prescribing guidance.
Review study design, recency, population, risk of bias, external validity, and article-level reuse rights before using an article in a curated card.

sources.name: Open RN — Nursing Pharmacology, 2nd edition (2023)
sources.publisher: Chippewa Valley Technical College / Open Resources for Nursing
use_limits: The book is explicitly not intended to be used as a drug reference.
Use only for foundational education, preserve attribution and license notice, and do not treat textbook excerpts as patient-specific medication authority.
The PDF is very large (about 145 MB); keep downloaded source files in a local rights-cleared folder and do not duplicate the entire book inside the application repository.

sources.name: Public Health in Pharmacy Practice: A Casebook, 2nd edition (2021)
sources.attribution: Covvey, J. R., Arya, V., DiPietro Mager, N. A., Gilman, N. V., Herring, M., Lukas, S., Ochs, L., & Waddington, L. (2021). Public Health in Pharmacy Practice: A Casebook (2nd ed.). Milne Open Textbooks. CC BY 4.0.
sources.content_rights: CC BY 4.0 except where otherwise noted; chapter-level and third-party rights review required before reusing specific content
use_limits: Public health pharmacy teaching casebook, not dental prescribing guidance or a current medicine monograph.
Book is CC BY 4.0 except where otherwise noted. Confirm the exact chapter and third-party rights before extracting or adapting content.
Use only for education and medication-safety concepts; never as the sole basis for a patient-specific drug decision.

sources.name: UIC / Medicine LibreTexts — Essentials of Pharmacology
sources.publisher: University of Illinois Chicago / Medicine LibreTexts
sources.content_rights: CC BY 4.0 metadata at book level; check chapter-level and third-party notices
use_limits: Foundational pharmacology teaching text, not dental prescribing guidance or a current drug monograph.
Official reader offers a Download Full Book (PDF) option. Review chapter-level and third-party content notices before extracting or reusing content.
Do not turn textbook passages into patient-specific recommendations.
